VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n-mcp's IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses bypass SSRF protection in validateUrlSync(), enabling full SSRF for SDK embedders VULNERABILITY_ID affects n8n-mcp deployments embedding the SDK via N8NDocumentationMCPServer or N8NMCPEngine with user-supplied InstanceContext, on versions v2.47.4 through v2.47.13. The synchronous validator SSRFProtection.validateUrlSync() had no IPv6 checks, so IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses such as http://[::ffff:169.254.169.254] bypassed cloud-metadata, localhost and private-IP checks. An attacker who controls n8nApiUrl can receive response bodies from internal targets, and the n8nApiKey is forwarded in the x-n8n-api-key header to the attacker-controlled host.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Jupyter Notebook Vulnerable to Authentication Token Theft via CommandLinker XSS A stored XSS flaw in Jupyter Notebook lets attackers steal authentication tokens when users open malicious notebook files and click elements disguised as legitimate controls. The stolen token enables full account takeover through the Jupyter REST API, including reading and modifying files, accessing running kernels, and creating terminals.
affected_vendors_raw: Jupyter Notebook; JupyterLab; NVIDIA AI Red Team

model_text: VULNERABILITY_ID: Claude SDK for TypeScript has Insecure Default File Permissions in Local Filesystem Memory Tool The Anthropic TypeScript SDK's `BetaLocalFilesystemMemoryTool` created memory files and directories with the Node.js default modes (`0o666` for files, `0o777` for directories). On hosts with a standard umask these are world-readable, and under a permissive umask, such as many Docker base images, they are world-writable. A local attacker on a shared host could read persisted agent state, and in containers could modify memory files to influence later model behavior.
affected_vendors_raw: Claude SDK for TypeScript; Anthropic TypeScript SDK; BetaLocalFilesystemMemoryTool

model_text: VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: Webchat audio embedding could read local files without local-root containment OpenClaw deployments before 2026.4.15 could embed host-local audio files into webchat responses without the local media root containment check used by other media-serving paths. If an attacker could influence a tool-produced ReplyPayload.mediaUrl, the webchat audio embedding helper could read an audio-like file under the size cap and return it base64-encoded, crossing from model or tool output into a host file read.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n has Prototype Pollution in XML Webhook Body Parser that Leads to RCE A flaw in the `xml2js` library, used by n8n's webhook handler to parse XML request bodies, allows prototype pollution through a crafted XML payload. An authenticated user with permission to create or modify workflows can chain this with the Git node's SSH operations to achieve remote code execution on the n8n host.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n Vulnerable to XSS via MCP OAuth client An unauthenticated attacker can register a malicious MCP OAuth client with a crafted client_name. When a second user revokes access after a victim authorized the OAuth consent dialog, a toast notification renders the injected script. Clicking the link runs arbitrary JavaScript in the victim's authenticated n8n browser session, enabling credential and session token theft, workflow manipulation, or privilege escalation.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n's Credential Authorization Bypass in dynamic-node-parameters Allows Foreign API Key Replay The n8n dynamic-node-parameters endpoints did not check whether an authenticated caller was authorized to use a supplied credential reference. A user with access to a shared workflow could submit a foreign credential ID, causing the backend to decrypt and use another user's credential against a destination URL the caller controls, which effectively exfiltrates a reusable API key. The source says the issue is not limited to any single node type.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n Vulnerable to Unauthenticated Denial of Service via MCP Client Registration The MCP OAuth client registration endpoint in n8n accepted unauthenticated requests and stored client data without adequate resource controls. A remote attacker can exhaust server memory with large registration payloads, making the instance unavailable, and the endpoint remains reachable even when MCP is disabled.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n Vulnerable to Hijacking of Unauthenticated Chat Execution The `/chat` WebSocket endpoint used by n8n's Chat Trigger node did not verify that incoming connections were authorized for the target execution. An unauthenticated remote attacker who could identify a valid execution ID for a workflow in a waiting state could attach to that execution, receive the pending prompt meant for the legitimate user, and submit arbitrary input to resume or influence downstream workflow behavior. Exploitation requires a public Hosted Chat workflow with authentication set to `None`, a target execution in a waiting state, and knowledge of that execution ID.
affected_vendors_raw: n8n; n8n Chat Trigger node; n8n Hosted Chat

model_text: VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n has Open Redirect in MCP OAuth Consent Flow n8n's `/mcp-oauth/register` endpoint accepts OAuth client registrations without authentication, so arbitrary `redirect_uri` values can be registered. When a user clicks Deny on the MCP OAuth consent dialog, the `handleDeny` handler redirects them to that registered URI without validation, creating an open redirect. An attacker can send a phishing link that silently sends a victim to an external site after they deny consent.

VULNERABILITY_ID: In Spring AI, having access to a shared environment can expose the ONNX model used by the application. Affected version… VULNERABILITY_ID affects Spring AI, where access to a shared environment can expose the ONNX model the application uses. Affected versions are 1.0.0 through 1.0.5 and 1.1.0 through 1.1.4, with CWE-377 (Insecure Temporary File) listed as the weakness. NVD has not yet provided an assessment.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A security vulnerability has been detected in ErlichLiu claude-agent-sdk-master up to… VULNERABILITY_ID affects ErlichLiu claude-agent-sdk-master up to commit b185aa7ff0d864581257008077b4010fca1747bf. Manipulating the outputFile argument in app/api/agent-output/route.ts leads to path traversal, and the attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be used, and the project was informed through an issue report but has not responded.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A weakness has been identified in ChatGPTNextWeb NextChat up to 2.16.1. This affects the function storeUrl of the file… VULNERABILITY_ID is a weakness in ChatGPTNextWeb NextChat up to 2.16.1, located in the storeUrl function of app/api/artifacts/route.ts in the Artifacts Endpoint component. Manipulating the ID argument causes server-side request forgery (CWE-918), and the attack can be started remotely. A public exploit exists, and the project was informed via an issue report but has not yet responded.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A security flaw has been discovered in ChatGPTNextWeb NextChat up to 2.16.1. Affected by this issue is the function… VULNERABILITY_ID is a server-side request forgery flaw in ChatGPTNextWeb NextChat up to 2.16.1. It sits in the proxyHandler function of app/api/[provider]/[...path]/route.ts, and remote attackers can trigger it. The exploit has been released publicly, and the project was informed through an issue report but had not responded at the time of the source.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A vulnerability was found in vllm up to 0.19.0. The affected element is the function has_mamba_layers of the file… A vulnerability in vllm up to 0.19.0 affects the function has_mamba_layers in vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py, part of the KV Block Handler component. Manipulating it leads to an uninitialized resource, and the attack can be launched remotely. The attack is complexity and difficult to exploit, but a public exploit exists.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A weakness has been identified in Toowiredd chatgpt-mcp-server up to 0.1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown… A weakness in Toowiredd chatgpt-mcp-server up to 0.1.0 allows OS command injection through an unknown function in src/services/docker.service.ts, affecting the MCP/HTTP component. The issue is remotely exploitable, and a public exploit is available, while the project has not yet responded to the early issue report.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A security flaw has been discovered in Ollama up to 0.20.2. This affects the function digestToPath of the file… A path traversal flaw has been reported in Ollama up to 0.20.2, in the digestToPath function of x/imagegen/transfer/transfer.go within the Tensor Model Transfer Handler component. Manipulating the digest argument enables the traversal, and the attack can be launched remotely but has high complexity and is reported as difficult to exploit. A public exploit exists, and the vendor did not respond to early disclosure.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n-MCP: Sensitive MCP tool-call arguments logged on authenticated requests in HTTP mode In HTTP transport mode, n8n-mcp versions v2.47.12 and earlier wrote full MCP tools/call arguments and JSON-RPC params to server logs for authenticated requests, before redaction. When a call carried credentials, such as through n8n_manage_credentials.data, the raw values could be persisted in logs, exposing bearer tokens, OAuth credentials, API keys and webhook auth headers to anyone with access to collected or forwarded logs. The issue requires a valid AUTH_TOKEN, and the stdio transport is not affected in practice.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LiteLLM: Authenticated command execution via MCP stdio test endpoints LiteLLM's two MCP preview endpoints, POST /mcp-rest/test/connection and POST /mcp-rest/test/tools/list, accepted full server configurations including command, args and env for the stdio transport. Calling them with a stdio configuration spawned the supplied command as a subprocess on the proxy host with the proxy process's privileges. Because the endpoints checked only for a valid proxy API key and no role, any authenticated user, including low-privilege internal-user keys, could run arbitrary commands on the host.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LangChain is a framework for building agents and LLM-powered applications. Prior to 1.1.14, langchain-openai's… LangChain versions prior to 1.1.14 contain a flaw in the langchain-openai package's _url_to_size() helper, which get_num_tokens_from_messages uses for image token counting. The helper validates a URL against SSRF protections, then fetches it in a separate network operation with independent DNS resolution. An attacker-controlled hostname can resolve to a public IP during validation and to a private or localhost IP during the fetch, a TOCTOU / DNS rebinding window.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LangChain is a framework for building agents and LLM-powered applications. Prior to langchain-text-splitters 1.1.2… LangChain's langchain-text-splitters, prior to 1.1.2, validated the initial URL in HTMLHeaderTextSplitter.split_text_from_url() but fetched it with requests.get() while redirects were enabled and never revalidated redirect targets. An attacker-controlled URL could therefore redirect to internal, localhost, or cloud metadata endpoints, bypassing SSRF protections. Exfiltration depends on the application: it is possible only if the returned Document contents are exposed back to the requester who supplied the URL.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Gemini CLI: Remote Code Execution via workspace trust and tool allowlisting bypasses Gemini CLI (`@google/gemini-cli`) and the `run-gemini-cli` GitHub Action are updated to harden workspace trust and tool allowlisting, especially in untrusted environments such as GitHub Actions. In headless mode, earlier versions automatically trusted workspace folders, so malicious environment variables in a local `.gemini/` directory could lead to remote code execution, and under `--yolo` the fine-grained tool allowlist in `~/.gemini/settings.json` was ignored. The update requires explicit folder trust and makes the policy engine evaluate tool allowlisting under `--yolo` (version `0.39.1`), which can break existing CI/CD workflows.
affected_vendors_raw: Gemini CLI; run-gemini-cli GitHub Action; Gemini

model_text: VULNERABILITY_ID: k8sGPT has Prompt Injection through its k8sGPT-Operator k8sGPT's auto-remediation pipeline deserializes AI-generated YAML directly into a Deployment object in `object_to_execution.go`, without validating it against the original Deployment object. The issue was fixed after coordination with Alex Jones, and the proof of concept was shared only with the maintainers.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Claude Code: Trust Dialog Bypass via Git Worktree Spoofing Allows Arbitrary Code Execution Claude Code used the git worktree `commondir` file to determine folder trust without validating its contents. A crafted repository whose `commondir` points to a path the victim had already trusted could bypass the trust dialog and run malicious hooks defined in `.claude/settings.json`. Exploitation required the victim to clone the malicious repository, run Claude Code inside it, and the attacker to know or guess a previously trusted path.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LiteLLM has SQL Injection in Proxy API key verification LiteLLM's proxy API key verification mixed the caller-supplied key value into a database query instead of passing it as a separate parameter, enabling SQL injection. An unauthenticated attacker can send a crafted Authorization header to any LLM API route, such as POST /chat/completions, and reach the query through the proxy's error-handling path. The attacker can read proxy database data and may modify it, gaining unauthorised access to the proxy and the credentials it manages.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Ray: Remote Code Execution via Parquet Arrow Extension Type Deserialization Ray Data registers three custom Arrow extension types (ray.data.arrow_tensor, ray.data.arrow_tensor_v2, ray.data.arrow_variable_shaped_tensor) globally in PyArrow. When PyArrow reads a Parquet file with one of these types, Ray's __arrow_ext_deserialize__ passes the field metadata bytes to cloudpickle.loads(), enabling arbitrary code execution during schema parsing, before any row data is read. The source states that a related fix from May 2024 was reintroduced in July 2025 via PR #54831.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LiteLLM: Server-Side Template Injection in /prompts/test endpoint LiteLLM's POST /prompts/test endpoint rendered user-supplied prompt templates without sandboxing, so a crafted template could run arbitrary code inside the LiteLLM Proxy process. Any caller with a valid proxy API key can reach the endpoint, which may expose environment secrets and allow host commands depending on deployment.

VULNERABILITY_ID: The BetterDocs plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Missing Authorization in versions up to and including 4.3.11. This… VULNERABILITY_ID affects the BetterDocs plugin for WordPress in versions up to and including 4.3.11. The generate_openai_content_callback() function lacks a capability check and relies only on a nonce, so authenticated users with subscriber-level access and above can trigger OpenAI API calls with arbitrary prompts. Each call uses the site's configured API key, consuming the site owner's paid AI API quota.

VULNERABILITY_ID: AnythingLLM is an application that turns pieces of content into context that any LLM can use as references during… AnythingLLM versions prior to 1.12.1 contain a stored DOM-level XSS flaw, tracked as VULNERABILITY_ID. The in-chat markdown renderer interpolates image `alt` text into an HTML attribute without encoding, and the `Chartable` component renders chart captions with no DOMPurify sanitization. An attacker who can influence LLM output, through indirect prompt injection in a shared workspace document or by creating a chart record in a multi-user workspace, can run script in other users' browsers when they open that conversation.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Url redirection to untrusted site ('open redirect') in M365 Copilot allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate… VULNERABILITY_ID is an open redirect (CWE-601) in M365 Copilot, a hosted service. The flaw is a URL redirection to an untrusted site, which allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network. NVD has not yet provided an assessment; Microsoft Corporation is the source, and NVD published the entry on 04/23/2026.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Pipecat: Remote Code Execution by Pickle Deserialization Through LivekitFrameSerializer A flaw in Pipecat's LivekitFrameSerializer, an optional, non-default, undocumented serializer deprecated in version 0.0.90, passes untrusted WebSocket message data directly to pickle.loads() in deserialize() in src/pipecat/serializers/livekit.py. A remote client that can reach a server using this serializer, for example one bound to 0.0.0.0, can send a crafted pickle payload to execute arbitrary code on the server with the Pipecat service's privileges.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise is a drag & drop user interface to build a customized large language model flow. Prior to 3.1.0, the core… VULNERABILITY_ID affects Flowise, a drag and drop user interface for building customized large language model flows, prior to 3.1.0. The core security wrappers secureAxiosRequest and secureFetch, meant to prevent Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF), contain multiple logic flaws that let attackers bypass the allow and deny lists through DNS Rebinding (Time-of-Check Time-of-Use) or through the default configuration, which enforces no deny list. The weakness is classified as CWE-918.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise is a drag & drop user interface to build a customized large language model flow. Prior to 3.1.0, a Server-Side… VULNERABILITY_ID affects Flowise before 3.1.0. The Custom Function feature allows SSRF protection bypass because the built-in Node.js http, https, and net modules are permitted in the NodeVM sandbox without the HTTP_DENY_LIST checks that cover axios and node-fetch. Authenticated users can use these modules to reach internal network resources, such as cloud provider metadata services.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise is a drag & drop user interface to build a customized large language model flow. Prior to 3.1.0, the Chatflow… Flowise, a drag-and-drop interface for building customized large language model flows, is affected before version 3.1.0. The Chatflow configuration file upload settings can be modified to allow the application/javascript MIME type, letting an attacker upload.js files that the frontend does not normally permit. This allows persistent storage of malicious Node.js web shells on the server, potentially leading to Remote Code Execution (RCE).

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise is a drag & drop user interface to build a customized large language model flow. Prior to 3.1.0, an improper… Flowise, a drag-and-drop interface for building LLM flows, has an improper mass assignment (JSON injection) flaw in the account registration endpoint of Flowise Cloud before version 3.1.0. Unauthenticated attackers can inject server-managed fields and nested objects during account creation, letting them set ownership metadata, timestamps, organization association and role mappings, which breaks trust boundaries in the multi-tenant environment.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n-MCP Logs Sensitive Request Data on Unauthorized /mcp Requests Versions 2.47.10 and earlier of n8n-mcp, when run in HTTP transport mode, wrote request metadata for incoming POST /mcp requests to server logs even when authentication failed. Sensitive values from those rejected requests, including bearer tokens from the Authorization header, per-tenant x-n8n-key API keys, and JSON-RPC payloads, could therefore be persisted and exposed to anyone with access to collected logs. Access control itself was not bypassed, since unauthenticated requests received 401 Unauthorized, and the stdio transport is not affected.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Prior to version… Paperclip, a Node.js server and React UI for orchestrating AI agents, is affected by VULNERABILITY_ID in versions prior to 2026.416.0. An unauthenticated attacker can achieve full remote code execution on any network-accessible instance running in `authenticated` mode with default configuration, using a six-call API chain requiring no credentials or user interaction.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Paperclip is a Node.js server and React UI that orchestrates a team of AI agents to run a business. Versions of… Versions of @paperclipai/server prior to 2026.416.0 contain a privilege escalation flaw. Agents can update their own adapterConfig through the /agents/:id endpoint, and the server later executes adapterConfig.workspaceStrategy.provisionCommand during workspace provisioning. An attacker holding an Agent API key can inject shell commands that run on the Paperclip server host, which the source describes as remote code execution.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A vulnerability was determined in ericc-ch copilot-api up to 0.7.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file /token… VULNERABILITY_ID affects ericc-ch copilot-api up to 0.7.0. A manipulated Host argument sent to the /token endpoint of the Header Handler component can lead to reliance on reverse DNS resolution (CWE-350). The attack can be performed remotely, the exploit has been publicly disclosed, and the vendor did not respond to early contact., assessed by VulDB; NIST has not yet provided an assessment.

VULNERABILITY_ID: engram: HTTP server CORS wildcard + auth-off-by-default enables CSRF graph exfiltration and persistent indirect prompt injection The local HTTP server started by `engram server` (default `127.0.0.1:7337`) accepted requests from any browser origin with no authentication unless `ENGRAM_API_TOKEN` was set. Combined with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *` and a body parser that did not require `Content-Type: application/json`, a malicious web page could read the knowledge graph via `GET /query` and `GET /stats`, and write persistent prompt-injection payloads via `POST /learn`, which were later surfaced to the user's AI coding agent. Affected versions are `engramx` >= 1.0.0 and < 2.0.2.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A flaw was found in InstructLab. The `linux_train.py` script hardcodes `trust_remote_code=True` when loading models… VULNERABILITY_ID affects InstructLab. The `linux_train.py` script hardcodes `trust_remote_code=True` when loading models from HuggingFace, so a remote attacker can achieve arbitrary Python code execution by persuading a user to run `ilab train/download/generate` with a crafted malicious model from the HuggingFace Hub. The weakness is classified as CWE-829, and NVD had not yet provided an assessment at publication.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise is a drag & drop user interface to build a customized large language model flow. Prior to 3.1.0, due to unsafe… Flowise versions prior to 3.1.0 contain a flaw in the MCP adapter's serialization of stdio commands. An authenticated user can add an MCP stdio server through the "Custom MCP" configuration with an arbitrary command, bypassing validateCommandInjection and validateArgsForLocalFileAccess by pairing an allowed command such as "npx" with code execution arguments like "-c touch /tmp/pwn", which achieves command execution on the underlying OS.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: CSV Agent Prompt Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability Trend Micro's Zero Day Initiative reports an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in FlowiseAI Flowise, tested at version 3.0.13. The flaw sits in the run method of the CSV_Agents class, which evaluates an LLM-generated Python script without proper sandboxing. The input validation that checks for forbidden patterns can be bypassed, allowing arbitrary OS commands to run on the server as the user running it.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LMDeploy is a toolkit for compressing, deploying, and serving large language models. Versions prior to 0.12.3 have a… VULNERABILITY_ID is a Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) flaw in LMDeploy versions prior to 0.12.3, within the vision-language module. The load_image() function in lmdeploy/vl/utils.py fetches arbitrary URLs without checking for internal or private IP addresses, letting an attacker reach cloud metadata services, internal networks and sensitive resources. The weakness is classified as CWE-918.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A vulnerability was found in ericc-ch copilot-api up to 0.7.0. The impacted element is the function cors of the file… VULNERABILITY_ID affects ericc-ch copilot-api up to 0.7.0. A flaw in the function cors of src/server.ts, in the Token Endpoint component, produces a permissive cross-domain policy that accepts untrusted domains. The attack can be launched remotely, and public exploit code exists. The weaknesses are CWE-346 and CWE-942.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A vulnerability was detected in lm-sys fastchat up to 0.2.36. Impacted is the function add_text of the component Arena… VULNERABILITY_ID affects lm-sys fastchat up to 0.2.36, specifically the add_text function of the Arena Side-by-Side View Handler component. The flaw is an incorrect control flow (CWE-670) that can be triggered remotely, and a public exploit now exists.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A security vulnerability has been detected in lm-sys fastchat up to 0.2.36. This issue affects the function… VULNERABILITY_ID affects lm-sys FastChat up to 0.2.36. A manipulation of the api_generate function in the Worker API Endpoint component leads to resource consumption and can be initiated remotely, and a public exploit has been disclosed.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A flaw has been found in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.8.3. This affects an unknown function of the file… VULNERABILITY_ID is a flaw in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.8.3, in the Frontend React Component Rendering component, specifically the file src/frontend/src/modals/IOModal/components/chatView/chatMessage/components/edit-message.tsx. Manipulating this function can lead to cross site scripting, and the attack may be launched remotely. A published exploit exists, and the vendor did not respond to early contact about the disclosure.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A vulnerability was detected in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.8.3. The impacted element is the function… A vulnerability was detected in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.8.3. The flaw sits in the function get_client_ip/install_mcp_config in src/backend/base/langflow/api/v1/mcp_projects.py, part of the Model Context Protocol Configuration API. Manipulating the X-Forwarded-For argument results in injection, and the attack may be initiated remotely. A public exploit exists, and the vendor did not respond to early disclosure.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A security vulnerability has been detected in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.8.3. The affected element is the function… A vulnerability in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.8.3 affects the function create_project/encrypt_auth_settings in src/backend/base/Langflow/api/v1/projects.py, part of the Project Creation Endpoint. Manipulating the auth_settings argument leads to cleartext storage in a file or on disk. The attack can be launched remotely, and a public exploit has been disclosed and may be used. The vendor was contacted early but did not respond.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A weakness has been identified in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.8.3. Impacted is the function… VULNERABILITY_ID is a weakness in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.8.3, located in the function remove_api_keys/has_api_terms in src/backend/base/langflow/api/utils/core.py, within the component Flow Using API. The flaw causes unprotected storage of credentials and can be initiated remotely. A public exploit is available, and the vendor did not respond to early disclosure contact.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A security flaw has been discovered in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.1.0. This issue affects the function… VULNERABILITY_ID is a flaw in langflow-ai langflow up to 1.1.0, in the create_upload_file function of src/backend/base/Langflow/api/v1/endpoints.py in the API Endpoint component. It allows unrestricted upload and can be exploited remotely. The exploit has been publicly released, and the vendor did not respond to early disclosure contact. CWE-284 (Improper Access Control) and CWE-434 (Unrestricted Upload of File with Dangerous Type) are associated with it.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Airtable_Agent Code Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability Flowise 3.0.13, tested on Ubuntu 25.10, has an unauthenticated remote code execution flaw in the run method of the Airtable_Agents class. The method evaluates an LLM-generated Python script in a non-sandboxed environment, and a regex-based check (validatePythonCodeForDataFrame() with FORBIDDEN_PATTERNS) is the only guard before execution. An attacker can run arbitrary code as the user running the server.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Claude Code: Insecure System-Wide Configuration Loading Enables Local Privilege Escalation on Windows Claude Code on Windows loaded system-wide defaults from C:\ProgramData\ClaudeCode\managed-settings.json without checking directory ownership or permissions. A low-privileged local user could create that directory and place a malicious configuration file, which would load for any user launching Claude Code on the same machine. Exploitation requires a shared multi-user Windows system and a victim who launches Claude Code after the file is placed.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: QQBot media tags could read arbitrary local files through reply text The openclaw npm package, versions below 2026.4.10, let QQBot outbound media tags in AI reply text reference host-local paths outside the intended media storage boundary. This allowed local file disclosure through outbound media handling, and the fix enforces the boundary for all outbound QQBot local file paths.

VULNERABILITY_ID: FastGPT is an AI Agent building platform. In versions prior to 4.14.9.5, the password change endpoint is vulnerable to… FastGPT, an AI Agent building platform, has a NoSQL injection flaw in its password change endpoint in versions prior to 4.14.9.5. An authenticated attacker can inject MongoDB query operators to bypass the "old password" check, changing the password of their own account or others' accounts when combined with ID manipulation, which leads to full account takeover and persistence.

VULNERABILITY_ID: FastGPT is an AI Agent building platform. In versions prior to 4.14.9.5, the password-based login endpoint uses… VULNERABILITY_ID affects FastGPT, an AI Agent building platform, in versions prior to 4.14.9.5. The password-based login endpoint uses TypeScript type assertion without runtime validation, so an unauthenticated attacker can submit a MongoDB query operator object such as {"$ne": ""} as the password field. This NoSQL injection bypasses the password check and allows login as any user, including the root administrator.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: Exec environment denylist missed high-risk interpreter startup variables OpenClaw's exec environment policy did not block interpreter startup variables such as VIMINIT, EXINIT, LUA_INIT and HOSTALIASES. Operator-supplied overrides of these variables could influence downstream execution or network behavior in affected versions below 2026.4.10. The fix expands the host environment security policy denylist to cover these and related high-risk variables.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Unauthenticated TTS endpoint accepts arbitrary credential IDs — enables API credit abuse via stored credentials The text-to-speech generate endpoint in Flowise, POST /api/v1/text-to-speech/generate, is whitelisted and requires no authentication. When called without a chatflowId, it takes an attacker-supplied credentialId from the request body and uses the stored credential, such as an OpenAI or ElevenLabs API key, to generate speech. An unauthenticated attacker can therefore spend a victim's API credits, and the source says this is trivially exploitable when combined with a credential ID leak described in Finding 2.
affected_vendors_raw: Flowise; OpenAI; ElevenLabs; Azure OpenAI; Google Cloud Text-to-Speech

model_text: VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Public chatflow endpoints return unsanitized flowData including plaintext API keys, passwords, and credential IDs The GET /api/v1/public-chatflows/:id endpoint in Flowise returns the full chatflow object without sanitization when a chatflow is public. In Docker validation against v3.0.13, the sanitizeFlowDataForPublicEndpoint function is absent from the released image, and both public-chatflows and public-chatbotConfig return raw flowData containing credential IDs, plaintext API keys, and passwords.

VULNERABILITY_ID: langchain-openai: Image token counting SSRF protection can be bypassed via DNS rebinding langchain-openai versions before 1.1.14 validated image URLs for SSRF protection in `_url_to_size()`, then fetched them with a separate DNS resolution, leaving a DNS rebinding window where a hostname could resolve to a public IP during validation and a private or localhost IP during the fetch. The fetched body is passed only to Pillow's `Image.open()` and never returned or logged, so an attacker cannot exfiltrate data, though blind probing of internal hosts and ports may be possible.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LangChain Text Splitters: HTMLHeaderTextSplitter.split_text_from_url SSRF Redirect Bypass LangChain Text Splitters before 1.1.2 has an SSRF bypass in HTMLHeaderTextSplitter.split_text_from_url(). The function validates only the initial URL with validate_safe_url() and then calls requests.get() with redirects enabled, so an attacker-controlled server can redirect the fetch to internal, localhost or cloud metadata endpoints such as AWS IMDSv1. Data exfiltration requires the application to return Document contents to the party that supplied the URL.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Paperclip: Cross-tenant agent API token minting via missing assertCompanyAccess on /api/agents/:id/keys The Paperclip agent routes POST, GET and DELETE on /api/agents/:id/keys (server/src/routes/agents.ts, lines 2050-2087) call only assertBoard and never assertCompanyAccess, so any authenticated board user can mint a plaintext pcp_* agent API token for an agent in any company. The token is bound to the victim agent's companyId, which lets an attacker perform operations inside the victim tenant. The same assertBoard-only pattern appears on the pause, resume, terminate and delete agent handlers.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Paperclip: OS Command Injection via Execution Workspace cleanupCommand Paperclip AI v2026.403.0 contains an OS command injection flaw in the Execution Workspace lifecycle (workspace-runtime.ts). The PATCH /api/execution-workspaces/:id endpoint stores an arbitrary cleanupCommand without validation, and the server later runs it through spawn(shell, ["-c", cleanupCommand]) when the workspace is archived. In local_trusted mode, which is the default for desktop installations, exploitation requires no authentication, and the commands run with the privileges of the Paperclip server process.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Paperclip: codex_local inherited ChatGPT/OpenAI-connected Gmail and was able to send real email A Paperclip-managed codex_local runtime used a Gmail connector the operator had connected only in the ChatGPT/OpenAI apps UI, without any Gmail connection configured in Paperclip or Codex. The runtime ran gmail_search_emails and gmail_send_email, sending a real outbound email from a personal Gmail account to an external party, followed by retraction messages after manual intervention. The reporter also states that the codex_local default for dangerouslyBypassApprovalsAndSandbox is true, which widens the impact.
affected_vendors_raw: Paperclip; codex_local; ChatGPT; OpenAI apps; Codex; Gmail connector

model_text: VULNERABILITY_ID: Paperclip: Malicious skills able to exfiltrate and destroy all user data A malicious skill can make an agent call PATCH /api/projects/{projectId}/workspaces/{workspaceId} to set a malicious runtimeConfig, then call the runtime-services/start endpoint. The server runs the unsanitized command via spawn() in server/src/services/workspace-runtime.ts, letting an attacker execute shell commands on the server and expose its environment variables, including API keys, JWT secrets and database credentials.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: resetPassword Authentication Bypass Vulnerability FlowiseAI Flowise version 3.0.12 contains an authentication bypass in the resetPassword method of the AccountService class. An unauthenticated remote attacker who knows a user's email address can submit a null or empty reset token to /api/v1/account/reset-password, because the code never verifies that a reset token was actually generated, and then set that user's password to a value of their choosing.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Cypher Injection in GraphCypherQAChain The GraphCypherQAChain node in Flowise passes user input directly into the Cypher query pipeline without sanitization, in the run method of packages/components/nodes/chains/GraphCypherQAChain/GraphCypherQAChain.ts (lines 193-219). An attacker with access to a vulnerable chatflow prediction endpoint (/api/v1/prediction/{flowId}) can inject arbitrary Cypher executed against the connected Neo4j database, enabling data exfiltration, modification, deletion, and schema discovery. Exploitation requires a chatflow using the Graph Cypher QA Chain node, a Chat Model, and a Neo4j Graph node with valid credentials.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Password Reset Link Sent Over Unsecured HTTP The password reset functionality on cloud.flowiseai.com sends reset password links over unsecured HTTP instead of HTTPS. An attacker on the same network as the victim, such as on public Wi-Fi, can intercept the link and capture the reset token, enabling hijack of the password reset session and potential account compromise.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Unauthenticated OAuth 2.0 Access Token Disclosure via Public Chatflow in Flowise Flowise contains an authentication bypass that lets an unauthenticated attacker obtain OAuth 2.0 access tokens tied to a public chatflow. The GET /api/v1/public-chatbotConfig/<chatflowId> endpoint returns internal flowData without authentication, including OAuth credential identifiers. The POST /api/v1/oauth2-credential/refresh/<credentialId> endpoint then refreshes tokens without authentication or authorization checks, enabling access to third-party services such as Gmail.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: APIChain Prompt Injection SSRF in GET/POST API Chains FlowiseAI's POST and GET API Chain components build request URLs from LLM output without validating them against the intended API documentation. Unauthenticated attackers can inject a crafted documentation prompt that overrides the BASE URL, causing the server to send arbitrary HTTP requests to internal and external hosts, as demonstrated against /flag on host.docker.internal:8080. The source affects FlowiseAI instances at version 2.2.1 and below.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: SSRF Protection Bypass (TOCTOU & Default Insecure) The secureAxiosRequest and secureFetch wrappers in Flowise's packages/components/src/httpSecurity.ts are meant to block SSRF but can be bypassed. When HTTP_DENY_LIST is unset, checkDenyList returns immediately and allows all requests, including localhost. A DNS rebinding attack exploits the gap between the dns.lookup used for validation and the second lookup the HTTP client makes, letting an attacker serve a safe IP first and an internal address such as 127.0.0.1 afterward. The confidentiality risk arises because internal services become reachable.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: SSRF Protection Bypass via Unprotected Built-in HTTP Modules in Custom Function Sandbox The Flowise Custom Function feature applies SSRF protection only to the axios and node-fetch libraries through the HTTP_DENY_LIST setting. The built-in http, https and net modules are passed to the NodeVM sandbox without that protection, so an authenticated user can import them directly and reach internal resources such as cloud metadata services. The advisory includes a proof of concept that retrieves IAM role credentials from the AWS EC2 metadata endpoint at 169.254.169.254.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: File Upload Validation Bypass in createAttachment Flowise's Chatflow file upload settings accept the application/javascript MIME type when a Chatflow is updated, even though the web interface does not offer JavaScript as an upload type. An authenticated attacker can therefore upload.js files and persistently store a Node.js web shell on the server, potentially leading to Remote Code Execution. The advisory describes this as a bypass of VULNERABILITY_ID (VULNERABILITY_ID).

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Parameter Override Bypass Remote Command Execution Flowise is vulnerable to unauthenticated remote command execution through a parameter override bypass. The FILE-STORAGE:: check in replaceInputsWithConfig in packages/server/src/utils/index.ts uses.includes() rather than.startsWith(), so an attacker can embed the keyword in a string and skip the isParameterEnabled() check. This lets the attacker set NODE_OPTIONS through the Custom MCP node, which does not block it, and run arbitrary code with root privileges in the container. The attack requires a single HTTP request, plus API Override enabled and a public chatflow containing an MCP tool node.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Sensitive Data Leak in public-chatbotConfig The /api/v1/public-chatbotConfig/:id endpoint in Flowise returns the full flowData object without authentication or sanitization, through the getSinglePublicChatbotConfig function in packages/server/src/services/chatflows/index.ts. An attacker who knows only a chatflow UUID, which can be obtained from embedded chat widgets, referrer headers or logs, can retrieve plaintext password-type fields such as unstructuredAPIKey and HTTP Authorization headers. The impact covers all Flowise Cloud users with such chatflows and self-hosted instances exposed to the internet.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Improper Mass Assignment in Account Registration Enables Unauthorized Organization Association VULNERABILITY_ID describes an improper mass assignment flaw in the POST /api/v1/account/register endpoint of Flowise Cloud. The backend maps client-supplied JSON directly to internal models without an allowlist or DTO validation, so an unauthenticated attacker can set organization, organizationUser, role and timestamp fields during registration. The source says this lets an attacker attach a new account to an existing organization they do not belong to, with a chosen role, across a multi-tenant boundary.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Code Injection in CSVAgent leads to Authenticated RCE Flowise's CSVAgent accepts a user-supplied custom Pandas read_csv code string and interpolates it without sanitization into code that pyodide executes on the server. An authenticated user can create a chatflow containing that node and trigger it through /api/v1/prediction/[CHATFLOWID], achieving remote code execution. If FLOWISE_USERNAME and FLOWISE_PQSSWORD are unset, the x-request-from: internal header bypasses authentication entirely.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Flowise: Remote code execution vulnerability in AirtableAgent.ts caused by lack of input verification when using `Pandas`. The AirtableAgent node in FlowiseAI passes user input directly into the question parameter of an LLM prompt template, and the generated output is executed as Python code through Pyodide and Pandas without sanitization. An attacker can bypass the intended LLM behavior with a prompt injection and achieve remote code execution. The advisory is tracked as VULNERABILITY_ID.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LangSmith SDK: Streaming token events bypass output redaction The LangSmith SDK's output redaction controls, hideOutputs in JS and hide_outputs in Python, do not cover streaming token events. Each streamed chunk is recorded as a new_token event holding the raw token value, and the redaction pipeline only processes the inputs and outputs fields, never the events array. Applications that rely on output redaction to keep sensitive LLM output out of LangSmith still leak the full streamed content through run events. Both the JS and Python SDKs are affected.

VULNERABILITY_ID: mcp-server-kubernetes is a Model Context Protocol server for Kubernetes cluster management. Versions 3.4.0 and prior… mcp-server-kubernetes, a Model Context Protocol server for Kubernetes cluster management, versions 3.4.0 and prior, contains an argument injection flaw (VULNERABILITY_ID) in the port_forward tool in src/tools/port_forward.ts. The tool builds a kubectl command by string concatenation and splits it on spaces before calling spawn(), so spaces in namespace, resourceType, resourceName, localPort and targetPort become argument boundaries. An attacker can inject arbitrary kubectl flags, such as --address=0.0.0.0 to expose internal Kubernetes services to the network or additional -n flags to target other namespaces, including through prompt injection against connected AI agents.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Giskard has Unsandboxed Jinja2 Template Rendering in ConformityCheck giskard-checks versions before 1.0.2b1 render the ConformityCheck rule parameter through Jinja2's default Template() constructor, so template expressions in rule definitions are evaluated at runtime. If check definitions come from an untrusted source, this can lead to arbitrary code execution, though the library is a local testing tool and exploitation requires write access to a check definition followed by a developer running the test suite.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Giskard has a Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS) in RegexMatching Check The RegexMatching check in the giskard-checks package passes a user-supplied pattern directly to re.search() in text_matching.py (line 457), with no timeout, complexity guard, or pattern validation. An attacker who controls the pattern or the matched text can trigger catastrophic backtracking, hanging the process and denying service, though exploitation requires write access to a check definition and execution of the test suite.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Improper neutralization of special elements used in a command ('command injection') in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio… VULNERABILITY_ID is a command injection flaw (CWE-77) in GitHub Copilot and Visual Studio Code. The source states that an authorized attacker can use it to disclose information over a network. NIST has not yet provided an NVD assessment, and the CVE was published on 04/14/2026.

VULNERABILITY_ID: SSH/SCP option injection allowing local RCE in @aiondadotcom/mcp-ssh Versions of @aiondadotcom/mcp-ssh before 1.3.5 passed the attacker-influenced hostAlias argument to ssh and scp without an argument terminator, so a value such as -oProxyCommand=... ran attacker-supplied commands locally before any network connection. On Windows, spawn with shell: true also let cmd.exe interpret shell metacharacters in hostAlias, command, localPath and remotePath. The LLM driving the server can be steered by prompt injection from untrusted content, so no malicious user is required.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) has a Code Injection and Missing Authentication vulnerability A Code Injection and Missing Authentication flaw in Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) versions 1.7.0 (and 2.0.0a1) through 1.28.1 (and 2.0.0a2) affects Python (OSS), Cloud Run and GKE deployments. An unauthenticated remote attacker can execute arbitrary code on the server hosting the ADK instance.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A vulnerability was detected in zhayujie chatgpt-on-wechat CowAgent up to 2.0.4. This affects an unknown function of… VULNERABILITY_ID affects an unknown function of the Agent Mode Service in zhayujie chatgpt-on-wechat CowAgent, up to version 2.0.4. Missing authentication allows remote manipulation, and a public exploit is available. The project was informed through an issue report but had not responded at the time of publication.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A weakness has been identified in zhayujie chatgpt-on-wechat CowAgent 2.0.4. The affected element is an unknown… VULNERABILITY_ID is a weakness in zhayujie chatgpt-on-wechat CowAgent 2.0.4, in an unknown function of the Administrative HTTP Endpoint component. The flaw is missing authentication (CWE-287, CWE-306) and can be exploited remotely, and a public exploit is available. The project was informed through an issue report but had not responded at the time of publication.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n-mcp has unauthenticated session termination and information disclosure in HTTP transport Several HTTP transport endpoints in n8n-mcp lacked proper authentication, and its health check endpoint exposed sensitive operational metadata without credentials. An unauthenticated attacker with network access to the HTTP server could disrupt active MCP sessions and gather information useful for further attacks.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LangSmith Client SDKs has Prototype Pollution in langsmith-sdk via Incomplete `__proto__` Guard in Internal lodash `set()` The LangSmith JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (langsmith, versions <= 0.5.17) contains an incomplete prototype pollution fix in its vendored lodash set() utility. The baseAssignValue() guard blocks only the __proto__ key, so a path such as constructor.prototype can still reach Object.prototype through the createAnonymizer() API when an attacker controls keys in the processed data. The source states this pollutes all objects in the Node.js process and ().

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAI Browser Server allows unauthenticated WebSocket clients to hijack connected extension sessions PraisonAI's browser bridge, started with `praisonai browser start`, binds to `0.0.0.0` by default, and its `/ws` endpoint accepts WebSocket clients that send no `Origin` header, because origin checks run only when that header is present. An unauthenticated network client can connect as a controller, send `start_session`, have the server forward `start_automation` to another idle extension WebSocket, and receive that session's action and status stream. The reporter verified this on praisonai version 4.5.134 at commit 365f75040f4e279736160f4b6bdb2bdb7a3968d4.

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAI: Coarse-Grained Tool Approval Cache Bypasses Per-Invocation Consent for Shell Commands PraisonAI Agents caches tool approval by tool name only, so approving one `execute_command` call (for example `ls -la`) silently approves every later `execute_command` call in the same execution context. Because `shell_tools.py` passes the full process environment to subprocesses through `os.environ.copy()`, an agent, possibly via prompt injection, can read secrets such as `OPENAI_API_KEY` without a further consent prompt.

VULNERABILITY_ID: FastGPT is an AI Agent building platform. Prior to 4.14.10.3, the /api/core/app/mcpTools/runTool endpoint accepts… VULNERABILITY_ID affects FastGPT, an AI Agent building platform, prior to 4.14.10.3. The /api/core/app/mcpTools/runTool endpoint accepts arbitrary URLs without authentication, and the internal IP check in isInternalAddress() blocks private IPs only when CHECK_INTERNAL_IP=true, which is not the default. Unauthenticated attackers can therefore perform SSRF against internal network resources.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Rembg is a tool to remove images background. Prior to 2.0.75, a path traversal vulnerability in the rembg HTTP server… VULNERABILITY_ID affects Rembg, a tool for removing image backgrounds, before version 2.0.75. A path traversal flaw in the rembg HTTP server lets unauthenticated remote attackers read arbitrary files from the server's filesystem by sending a crafted request with a malicious model_path parameter. The server attempts to load the file as an ONNX model, so error messages can reveal file existence, permissions, and potentially file contents.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw versions 2026.2.13 through 2026.3.24 contain an ANSI escape sequence injection vulnerability in approval… VULNERABILITY_ID affects OpenClaw versions 2026.2.13 through 2026.3.24. Untrusted tool metadata can carry ANSI control sequences into approval prompts and permission logs, so an attacker using malicious tool titles can spoof the terminal output users see. CWE-150 is assigned,

VULNERABILITY_ID: LiteLLM through 2026-04-08 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the… VULNERABILITY_ID affects LiteLLM through 2026-04-08. The source says remote attackers can execute arbitrary code via bytecode rewriting at the /guardrails/test_custom_code URI. The weakness is classified as CWE-420 (Unprotected Alternate Channel), and NVD has not yet provided an assessment.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A flaw has been found in zhayujie chatgpt-on-wechat CowAgent up to 2.0.4. This affects the function dispatch of the… A path traversal flaw, VULNERABILITY_ID, affects zhayujie chatgpt-on-wechat CowAgent up to 2.0.4. It sits in the function dispatch of agent/memory/service.py, reached through the API Memory Content Endpoint by manipulating the filename argument. The attack can be launched remotely, and a published exploit exists.

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAIAgents is a multi-agent teams system. Prior to 1.5.128, the web_crawl() function in… PraisonAIAgents, a multi-agent teams system, has a flaw in the web_crawl() function in praisonaiagents/tools/web_crawl_tools.py, affecting versions prior to 1.5.128. The function fetches arbitrary URLs supplied by AI agents without scheme allowlisting, hostname or IP blocklisting, or private network checks. An attacker, or prompt injection in crawled content, could force the agent to fetch cloud metadata endpoints, internal services, or local files via file:// URLs.

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAIAgents is a multi-agent teams system. Prior to 1.5.128, read_skill_file() in skill_tools.py allows reading… PraisonAIAgents, a multi-agent teams system, has a flaw in read_skill_file() in skill_tools.py prior to 1.5.128. The function accepts an unrestricted skill_path parameter, so it can read arbitrary files from the filesystem. Unlike file_tools.read_file, it enforces no workspace boundary confinement, and unlike run_skill_script it requires no critical-level approval, so an agent influenced by prompt injection can exfiltrate sensitive files without any approval prompt.

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAI is a multi-agent teams system. Prior to 4.5.128, the /media-stream WebSocket endpoint in PraisonAI's call… VULNERABILITY_ID affects PraisonAI, a multi-agent teams system, prior to 4.5.128. The /media-stream WebSocket endpoint in its call module accepts connections without authentication or Twilio signature validation, and each connection opens a session to OpenAI's Realtime API using the server's API key. With no limits on concurrent connections, message rate, or message size, an unauthenticated attacker can exhaust server resources and drain the victim's OpenAI API credits.

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAI is a multi-agent teams system. Prior to 4.5.128, deploy.py constructs a single comma-delimited string for the… PraisonAI, a multi-agent teams system, builds the gcloud run deploy --set-env-vars argument by directly interpolating openai_model, openai_key, and openai_base into a comma-delimited string without checking for commas. Because gcloud uses commas as the separator for key-value pairs, a comma in any of these values causes trailing text to be parsed as additional KEY=VALUE definitions, injecting arbitrary environment variables into the deployed Cloud Run service. The flaw is in deploy.py in versions prior to 4.5.128.

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAI is a multi-agent teams system. Prior to 4.5.128, the Flask API endpoint in src/praisonai/api.py renders agent… PraisonAI, a multi-agent teams system, prior to 4.5.128 renders agent output as HTML in the Flask API endpoint in src/praisonai/api.py without effective sanitization. The _sanitize_html function depends on the nh3 library, which pyproject.toml does not list as a required or optional dependency, so in the default installation it returns HTML unchanged. An attacker who can influence agent input, through RAG data poisoning, web scraping results or prompt injection, can inject JavaScript that runs in the browser of anyone viewing the API output.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: GIT_DIR and related git plumbing env vars missing from exec env denylist (VULNERABILITY_ID variant) OpenClaw, a user-controlled local assistant, did not remove Git plumbing environment variables such as GIT_DIR before host exec, so they could redirect Git operations. The flaw is a variant of VULNERABILITY_ID and affects the npm package openclaw at versions <=2026.3.30.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LangChain is a framework for building agents and LLM-powered applications. Prior to 0.3.84 and 1.2.28, LangChain's… LangChain versions prior to 0.3.84 and 1.2.28 contain incomplete f-string prompt-template validation (VULNERABILITY_ID). DictPromptTemplate and ImagePromptTemplate accepted templates with attribute access or indexing expressions and evaluated them during formatting, and validation based on top-level field names did not reject nested replacement fields inside format specifiers.

VULNERABILITY_ID: AGiXT is a dynamic AI Agent Automation Platform. Prior to 1.9.2, the safe_join() function in the essential_abilities… VULNERABILITY_ID affects AGiXT, an AI Agent Automation Platform, before version 1.9.2. The safe_join() function in the essential_abilities extension does not check that resolved file paths stay within the designated agent workspace. An authenticated attacker can use directory traversal sequences to read, write, or delete arbitrary files on the server hosting the AGiXT instance.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw B-M3: ClawHub package downloads are not enforced with integrity verification OpenClaw versions up to and including 2026.4.1 install ClawHub plugin archives without enforcing archive or per-file integrity metadata. The advisory is scoped to OpenClaw's user-controlled local assistant trust model, not a multi-tenant service.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw `node.pair.approve` placed in `operator.write` scope instead of `operator.pairing` allows unprivileged pairing approval OpenClaw's `node.pair.approve` method accepted the `operator.write` scope instead of the narrower `operator.pairing` scope and the admin requirement for exec-capable nodes. This allows an unprivileged caller to approve pairing. Affected versions are `<= v2026.04.01` of the `openclaw` npm package.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: Existing WS sessions survive shared gateway token rotation OpenClaw versions up to and including 2026.4.1 do not disconnect existing shared-token WebSocket sessions when the shared gateway token is rotated. The issue is fixed in npm package openclaw version 2026.4.8, and the advisory states the scope is OpenClaw's user-controlled local assistant trust model rather than a multi-tenant service boundary.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: resolvedAuth closure becomes stale after config reload A flaw in OpenClaw, an npm package, causes its resolvedAuth closure to remain stale after a config reload. Newly accepted gateway connections can then keep using stale resolved auth state. The advisory is scoped to OpenClaw's user-controlled local assistant trust model and does not assume a multi-tenant service boundary.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw `node.invoke(browser.proxy)` bypasses `browser.request` persistent profile-mutation guard OpenClaw's `node.invoke(browser.proxy)` path could mutate persistent browser profiles without passing through the `browser.request` guard. The advisory covers the `openclaw` npm package at versions up to and including v2026.04.01, and the issue is fixed in 2026.4.8.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw `device.token.rotate` mints tokens for unapproved roles, bypassing device role-upgrade pairing OpenClaw versions up to and including v2026.04.01 have a flaw in `device.token.rotate` that mints tokens for roles that never went through device role-upgrade pairing approval. Device token rotation could therefore create or keep roles and scopes the intended pairing approval would have blocked. The advisory scopes the issue to OpenClaw's user-controlled local assistant trust model, not a multi-tenant service.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: HGRCPATH, CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WRAPPER, RUSTC_WRAPPER, and MAKEFLAGS missing from exec env denylist — RCE via build tool env injection (VULNERABILITY_ID class) OpenClaw's exec environment denylist omits HGRCPATH, CARGO_BUILD_RUSTC_WRAPPER, RUSTC_WRAPPER and MAKEFLAGS, so hostile build-tool environment variables can influence host exec commands. The advisory states this enables RCE and is scoped to OpenClaw's user-controlled local assistant trust model, not a multi-tenant service. Affected versions are openclaw (npm) before 2026.4.8.

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAI Vulnerable to OS Command Injection PraisonAI's `execute_command` function, workflow shell steps (`_exec_shell` in `cli/features/job_workflow.py`) and action orchestrator pass user-controlled input to `subprocess.run()` with `shell=True`. Input from YAML workflow definitions, `agents.yaml` files, recipe steps and LLM-generated tool calls can therefore inject arbitrary shell commands through metacharacters such as `;`, `|`, `&&` and `$()`.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LangChain has incomplete f-string validation in prompt templates LangChain's f-string prompt-template validation was incomplete in two ways. DictPromptTemplate and ImagePromptTemplate accepted templates with attribute access or indexing expressions and evaluated them during formatting, and validation did not reject nested replacement fields inside format specifiers. Exposure needs untrusted template strings and richer Python objects passed into formatting.

VULNERABILITY_ID: A security flaw has been discovered in bigsk1 openai-realtime-ui up to 188ccde27fdf3d8fab8da81f3893468f53b2797c. The… A server-side request forgery flaw affects bigsk1 openai-realtime-ui up to commit 188ccde27fdf3d8fab8da81f3893468f53b2797c. The unknown function in server.js of the API Proxy Endpoint component is exploited by manipulating the Query argument, and the attack can be launched remotely. A public exploit exists, and the project uses continuous delivery with rolling releases, so no affected or fixed version numbers are available.

VULNERABILITY_ID: n8n-mcp has authenticated SSRF via instance-URL header in multi-tenant HTTP mode VULNERABILITY_ID describes an authenticated SSRF in n8n-mcp affecting versions up to and including 2.47.3. A caller holding a valid AUTH_TOKEN can make the server request arbitrary URLs supplied through multi-tenant HTTP headers, and response bodies are returned through JSON-RPC. Cloud instance metadata endpoints and internal network services are readable, and single-tenant stdio and non-multi-tenant HTTP deployments are not affected.

VULNERABILITY_ID: PraisonAI has sandbox escape via exception frame traversal in `execute_code` (subprocess mode) The `execute_code()` function in `praisonaiagents.tools.python_tools` defaults to `sandbox_mode="sandbox"`, which runs code in a subprocess with an AST blocklist. The subprocess wrapper's inline `blocked_attrs` set (line 143) omits `__traceback__`, `tb_frame`, `f_back` and `f_builtins`, which the direct-mode list blocks, letting attackers chain them through a caught exception to reach the wrapper's `builtins` and call `exec`. Tested on praisonaiagents 1.5.113 and rated.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LobeHub: Unauthenticated authentication bypass on `webapi` routes via forgeable `X-lobe-chat-auth` header VULNERABILITY_ID affects @lobehub/lobehub versions up to and including 2.1.47. The webapi authentication layer trusts the client-supplied X-lobe-chat-auth header, which is only XOR-obfuscated with a hardcoded key, and accepts any truthy apiKey in the decoded payload without validation, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to reach protected routes such as POST /webapi/chat/[provider] and GET /webapi/models/[provider] and to use the deployment's configured provider credentials and impersonate userIds. The advisory is rated Moderate () and maps to CWE-287, CWE-345 and CWE-290.

VULNERABILITY_ID: NiceGUI: Upload filename sanitization bypass via backslashes allows path traversal on Windows NiceGUI's upload filename sanitization, introduced in VULNERABILITY_ID, uses PurePosixPath(filename).name, which only treats forward slashes as separators. On Windows, an attacker can use backslashes in an upload filename to bypass this, enabling arbitrary file write outside the intended upload directory in applications that build paths from file.name. The impact includes data integrity loss and potential remote code execution, while Linux and macOS are not affected.

VULNERABILITY_ID: IBM Langflow Desktop 1.6.0 through 1.8.2 Langflow could allow an authenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the… VULNERABILITY_ID affects IBM Langflow Desktop versions 1.6.0 through 1.8.2. An authenticated user could execute arbitrary code on the system because an insecure default setting permits deserialization of untrusted data in the FAISS component. The weakness is classified as CWE-502, Deserialization of Untrusted Data.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LiteLLM: Password hash exposure and pass-the-hash authentication bypass LiteLLM stores user passwords as unsalted SHA-256 hashes and returns the password hash field from /user/info, /user/update and /spend/users to any authenticated user regardless of role. The /v2/login endpoint accepts the raw SHA-256 hash as a valid password, so an authenticated user can retrieve another user's hash and log in as that user, escalating privileges in three HTTP requests.

VULNERABILITY_ID: LibreChat is a ChatGPT clone with additional features. Prior to 0.8.4, LibreChat trusts the name field returned by the… LibreChat versions prior to 0.8.4 trust the name field returned by the execute_code sandbox when saving code-generated artifacts. On deployments using the default local file strategy, a filename containing traversal sequences such as../../../../../app/client/dist/poc.txt is concatenated into the server-side destination path and written with fs.writeFileSync() without sanitization. Any user who can trigger execute_code gets an arbitrary file write as the LibreChat server user.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Java-SDK has a DNS Rebinding Vulnerability The java-sdk MCP server contained a DNS rebinding vulnerability because it performed no Origin header validation before version 1.0.0, contrary to the MCP specification. An attacker can use a malicious website opened in a victim's browser to make arbitrary tool calls to a locally or privately networked MCP server, acting as a locally connected AI agent. Servers built on frameworks with built-in Origin validation, such as Spring AI, are not affected.

VULNERABILITY_ID: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a server crash by sending a… NVIDIA Triton Inference Server contains a vulnerability, VULNERABILITY_ID, classified as CWE-248 (Uncaught Exception). An attacker can crash the server by sending a malformed request header, which may lead to denial of service. NVD published the entry on 04/07/2026 and has not yet provided its own assessment.

VULNERABILITY_ID: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a server crash by sending a… VULNERABILITY_ID affects NVIDIA Triton Inference Server. VULNERABILITY_ID: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server contains a vulnerability where an attacker could cause a server crash by sending a… NVIDIA Triton Inference Server contains a vulnerability, tracked as VULNERABILITY_ID, where an attacker can cause a server crash by sending a malformed request. The source states that a successful exploit might lead to denial of service. The weakness is classified as CWE-190, Integer Overflow or Wraparound, and NVD published the entry on 04/07/2026.

VULNERABILITY_ID: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server contains a vulnerability in triton server where an attacker may cause an information… NVIDIA Triton Inference Server contains a vulnerability in its server component that lets an attacker cause information disclosure by uploading a model configuration. The source classifies it under CWE-22, Path Traversal. A successful exploit may lead to information disclosure or denial of service. NVD has not yet provided an assessment.

VULNERABILITY_ID: NVIDIA Triton Inference Server contains a vulnerability where insufficient input validation and a large number of… VULNERABILITY_ID affects NVIDIA Triton Inference Server. Insufficient input validation combined with a large number of outputs can crash the server, which a successful exploit may use to cause denial of service. The source tags the weakness as CWE-789, Memory Allocation with Excessive Size Value.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: Shared-secret comparison call sites leaked length information through timing Before OpenClaw 2026.4.2, several shared-secret comparison call sites used early length-mismatch checks instead of the shared fixed-length comparison helper. The affected paths could leak secret-length information through measurable timing differences, a side channel that did not by itself demonstrate auth bypass.

VULNERABILITY_ID: OpenClaw: QQ Bot structured payloads could read arbitrary local files Before OpenClaw 2026.4.2, crafted structured payloads sent through the QQ Bot media-send path could escape QQ Bot-owned media roots and read local files from attacker-chosen paths on the host. Affected versions are openclaw (npm) <= 2026.4.1, and the flaw was reported by @feiyang666 of Tencent zhuque Lab.

VULNERABILITY_ID: text-generation-webui is an open-source web interface for running Large Language Models. Prior to 4.3, an… VULNERABILITY_ID affects text-generation-webui, an open-source web interface for running Large Language Models, prior to 4.3. VULNERABILITY_ID: text-generation-webui is an open-source web interface for running Large Language Models. Prior to 4.3, he superbooga… VULNERABILITY_ID affects text-generation-webui before 4.3, specifically the superbooga and superboogav2 RAG extensions. These extensions fetch user-supplied URLs with requests.get() and perform no scheme check, IP filtering, or hostname allowlisting. VULNERABILITY_ID: text-generation-webui is an open-source web interface for running Large Language Models. Prior to 4.3, an… VULNERABILITY_ID affects text-generation-webui versions prior to 4.3. An unauthenticated path traversal flaw in load_preset() lets an attacker read any.yaml file on the server filesystem, and the parsed key-value pairs, including passwords, API keys and connection strings, are returned in the API response.

VULNERABILITY_ID: Anthropic Claude Code CLI and Claude Agent SDK contain an OS command injection vulnerability in authentication helper… Anthropic's Claude Code CLI and Claude Agent SDK run authentication helper configuration values through a shell (shell=true) without input validation. An attacker who can influence authentication settings, such as apiKeyHelper, awsAuthRefresh, awsCredentialExport, or gcpAuthRefresh, can inject shell metacharacters. This executes arbitrary commands with the privileges of the user or automation environment, enabling credential theft and environment variable exfiltration.
